hero.title: Handmade Leather Wallets, Made to Last.
hero.subtitle: Genuine leather wallets, stitched by hand and packed with care in Taroudant, Morocco.

packaging.title: Packed by Hand
packaging.description: Every wallet is wrapped with burlap fabric, natural rope, a thank-you card, and Loner Leather branding.

craft.title: Forty-one steps. Two hands. No machines.
paragraphs: Every Loner piece begins as a full hide, tanned with oak bark and pomegranate in a tannery three streets from our workshop. We choose the panels ourselves, rejecting anything with a scar we can't stand behind.

The leather is cut with a round knife, skived at the folds, then saddle-stitched with waxed linen thread — a stitch that will not unravel even if a thread breaks. Edges are bevelled, sanded, wet-slicked and waxed four times.
A wallet takes six hours. It leaves the bench only when the maker who started it signs off on it.
